vector_manifest.query_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

corpus_provenance.dataset: FinQA train/dev contexts, dev support-fact labels + SEC passages
corpus_provenance.selection: First eligible dev questions in original order; limit fixed before scoring; no model tuning.
corpus_provenance.judgments: Binary published supporting-fact labels, not exhaustive relevance judgments; not answer accuracy.
corpus_provenance.metadata: FinQA filename year is report year, not verified filing date; CIK joined to current SEC ticker map, historical identity not independently audited. Unmatched tickers excluded.
corpus_provenance.corpus: All eligible dev contexts, all table rows rendered uniformly. No gold strings or QA answers injected. SQLite dedup by source location and text hash. No corpus-sized Python list.

notes: Published FinQA binary supporting-fact labels are not exhaustive relevance judgments or answer correctness.
ranx receives descending ordinal scores to preserve the returned rank order, including Go deterministic ties; original real model/RRF scores are preserved in raw per-query rankings.
First 100 eligible dev queries chosen before scoring; no relevance tuning. Corpus contains train/dev context, as an unsupervised retrieval collection, not QA answer/program text.

PQ8 is IndexPQ(d=384,M=48,nbits=8), not scalar SQ8. Exact native payload includes codebooks and materialized auxiliary arrays; it excludes unknown allocator headers/capacity, model, and passage store.
RSS is separately observed in isolated real FAISS-only subprocesses, three per mode. Whole application RAM does not shrink by the vector payload percentage.
CPU-only serial end-to-end timings include BGE query encoding, Go parallel sparse/dense bridge, RRF and real MiniLM Top-50 to Top-10 reranking; not the Phase 1 sparse-only p99.
ID recall vs exact float32 may penalize interchangeable ties from identical text at different source locations.
